  FROM provider_taxa pt
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.nppes.healthcare_provider_taxonomy_code_set` t2 ON pt.taxonomy_code = t2.code
  WHERE t2.specialization IS NOT NULL AND t2.specialization != ''
  GROUP BY t2.specialization
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT specialization, distinct_npi_count
  FROM spec_counts
  ORDER BY distinct_npi_count DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(distinct_npi_count) as avg_count FROM top10
)

FROM top10 t, avg_count a
ORDER BY diff_from_avg ASC
LIMIT 1
